capabilities: Open a terminal rooted at a folder from the file explorer
Manage multi-tab shell sessions with per-tab settings
Run interactive programs like vim, ssh, and htop via an embedded Python PTY proxy
Search terminal output and click URLs in the buffer
Restore terminal tabs across Obsidian restarts
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true, not loaded on mobile). macOS requires python3 from Xcode Command Line Tools; Linux without python3 falls back to the script command; Windows is best-effort with winpty or plain cmd.exe. BRAT is recommended for beta/pre-release installs. Known limitation: closing a tab kills the session and a hard Obsidian quit may leave orphaned python3/shell child processes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a shell at a specific vault folder without leaving the app and navigating in an external terminal.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from the community browser

summary: Adds a hover icon to folders in the file explorer that opens a real PTY shell in a bottom panel, with the working directory set to that folder.
